_comment: Tax and invoicing policy for ColleagueAI sales. NOT APPROVED. It records the accountant's decisions (Accountant Decision Pack, questions T1-T14) and nothing in the code assumes them: while status is 'unapproved', live checkout is refused (lib/taxPolicy.js liveTaxBlocked), no Stripe Tax is calculated, no invoice is created and no tax wording is printed. To approve it: fill every decision and treatment with the accountant's written answer, set approval (who, role, date, and where the written answer is filed) and status 'approved'. tests/tax-policy.test.mjs refuses an 'approved' policy with any blocking decision, treatment or approval field left empty. Treatments are per buyer category (lib/taxPolicy.js classifyBuyer); 'action' is sell | hold | block, and every printed wording comes from here, never from code. FIRST-SALE SCOPE (founder decision 3, 21 Nov 2026): Czech businesses only (config/launch-scope.json); every other category is 'hold'. SELLER STATUS (22 Nov 2026): the founder reports that the company's accountant confirms Colleague AI s.r.o. is registered as an identified person (identifikovaná osoba), not a VAT payer, for 2026. seller.vatStatus is set to identified_person on that report. It is NOT an official record: vatId, vatEffectiveFrom and vatStatusEvidence.officialRecord stay null, the history entry stays verified:false, and lib/taxPolicy.js refuses approval until the registration decision (or the tax-register record) is on file. Earlier checks (21 Nov 2026: no VAT-payer entry in ARES; VIES INVALID for CZ29540852) are not contradicted by an identified-person registration only if the official record says so; the accountant reconciles them. A later VAT-payer registration (contemplated for 2027) is added as a verified history entry only from the official decision, and takes effect only with a re-approved policy. cz_business stays null until the accountant's written wording exists.
